doc_name: List of speakers of the West Pakistan Legislative Assembly
text: The Azad Kashmir government, along with the Government of Gilgit-Baltistan, operates within the framework of the Constitution of Pakistan and is governed by territorial election commissions that oversee elections, including provincial and territorial elections. These elections are conducted by political parties operating within the provinces and autonomous regions. The Speaker of the West Pakistan Legislative Assembly served as the presiding officer of that legislative body. Topics related to customs and regional issues are also addressed in this context.
